request.style: English, ambient soundscape, wind and distant rumble, swelling dark pads that fall away to near silence, a soft female voice, a single sustained tone at the end, no drums, 52 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Go out and stand on the mount before the Lord
And behold, the Lord passed by
A great and strong wind tore the mountains
But the Lord was not in the wind

[Verse]
After the wind an earthquake
But the Lord was not in the earthquake
After the earthquake a fire
But the Lord was not in the fire

[Chorus]
And after the fire
The sound of a low whisper
And after the fire
The sound of a low whisper

[Outro]
What are you doing here, Elijah
